arrangement.notes: Arrangement features a cinematic rise and fall in energy to create a dynamic, uplifting mainstream Boom Bap track utilizing varied sample chopping techniques for texture.

event_markers.label: micro_chops_intro
event_markers.reason: Introduce micro chops in drum channel

event_markers.label: reverse_chops_bridge
event_markers.reason: Use reverse chops in chords during bridge

event_markers.label: phrase_chops_verse
event_markers.reason: Phrase chops for melody layer in verse 2

event_markers.label: stutter_chops_final_hook
event_markers.reason: Highlight stutter chops in drums for final hook

sound_intent.timbral_focus: clear transient hits with warm sampled textures
sound_intent.spatial: moderate stereo spread with emphasis on front and center for vocals and drums

track_roles.drums: rhythm backbone with chops emphasizing groove
track_roles.bass: sub-bass foundation with supportive rhythmic patterns
track_roles.chords: harmonic texture with reverse chop accents
track_roles.vocal: vocal texture and chops adding rhythm and emotion

designer_intent.style: Mainstream Boom Bap with cinematic energy shaping
designer_intent.sample_layering: Highly textured using multiple chopping techniques for detail and variation

presetor_intent.processing: Clean and crisp transient shaping, mild compression, natural reverb
presetor_intent.effects: Delay and modulation on vocal chops, subtle phasing on reverse chords

sensei_drum.brief: Generate and arrange drums emphasizing varied chops: micro and stutter for groove dynamics.

bass_generator.brief: Create supportive bass parts with steady rhythmic presence matching the arrangement's energy curve.

harmony_generator.brief: Produce chord voicings incorporating reverse chop elements emphasizing harmonic movement.

melody_generator.brief: Design lead melodic elements focusing on phrase chops matching the uplifting mood.

ai_designer.brief: Shape the overall arrangement with attention to energy curve and emotional flow.

presetor.brief: Apply appropriate processing presets to maintain clarity and dynamic expression.

songgps.brief: Guide section transitions and energy shaping across arrangement.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance tracks ensuring the chop techniques are perceptible and blend well in mix.
